proposed_canonical.summary: Vagrant Story follows Ashley Riot into Leá Monde, a ruined city caught in a struggle over religious and political power.
body: Vagrant Story follows Ashley Riot into Leá Monde, a ruined city caught in a struggle over religious and political power. Square released the PlayStation game in 2000. Its enclosed streets, cellars and stone chambers place a solitary investigator inside a city that rarely offers a straightforward route or explanation.

Combat pauses while Ashley selects an enemy body part within his weapon's reach. Timed follow-up attacks extend a chain, but raise Risk. Continuing an attack can therefore make the next exchange less safe. The system asks for both a tactical choice before the blow and a rhythmic response after it.

Weapons develop different strengths against different enemy classes, and workshops allow equipment to be combined and adjusted. A disappointing hit can be a reason to reconsider the weapon rather than simply repeat the attack. Preparation makes the city's next locked room or unfamiliar creature a practical problem as well as a mystery.

body: Final Fantasy VIII begins with young people training for a profession that sends them into a war. Squall belongs to Balamb Garden, a school for mercenaries, and becomes a member of SeeD. Released for PlayStation in Japan in 1999, the game moves between school life, military assignments and his growing relationship with Rinoa.

Guardian Forces do more than appear as summoned creatures. Junctioning them opens abilities and lets stored magic improve a character's statistics. Draw supplies spells from enemies and other sources. Because a spell can be both something to cast and something to keep equipped, the inventory becomes part of character building.

Triple Triad places a compact card game inside this much larger journey. Its cards can be collected and played against people encountered along the way. Alongside the main battles and scenes, it gives towns and schools another reason to be revisited: someone there may have a hand worth challenging.

body: Warhorse Studios' Kingdom Come: Deliverance places Henry, the son of a blacksmith, in medieval Bohemia. His village is attacked and his ordinary life is broken apart by a wider political conflict. Released in 2018, the role-playing game approaches this setting through settlements, work and social encounters rather than a magical chosen-one premise.

A sword is not an automatic solution. Position, weapon choice and learned combat techniques matter, while quests can also be approached through persuasion, stealth or other decisions. Henry's developing abilities make early vulnerability part of the experience: the player and the character have things to learn.

The surrounding population reacts to what Henry does. Theft, violence and persuasion are ways of moving through a quest, but they also affect the people he must return to. The historical setting supplies more than scenery; it gives those encounters different expectations, restrictions and consequences.

body: Star Fox: Assault returns Fox McCloud to combat on GameCube, with Namco developing and Nintendo publishing. Its 2005 adventure moves between aerial battles, ground vehicles and action on foot. The familiar Arwing is one part of the battlefield rather than Fox's only place within it.

An Arwing offers speed and flight; a Landmaster tank brings heavy ground fire; Fox can also run and use handheld weapons. Those changes alter the scale of a location. Something crossed quickly from the air can become cover, a target or a route when approached on the ground.

The local multiplayer mode supports four people in split screen. Vehicles and on-foot combat become tools in a shared space, with each player watching a different view of the action. It preserves a familiar living-room arrangement: one console, several controllers and everyone close enough to see a rival's reaction.

A separate EX Gauge powers enhanced special moves and Critical Arts. The match becomes a sequence of small exchanges that also changes which larger responses remain available.

proposed_canonical.summary: Super Mario RPG brought Nintendo's characters into a role-playing adventure developed with Square.
body: Super Mario RPG brought Nintendo's characters into a role-playing adventure developed with Square. Released for Super Famicom in Japan in 1996, it sends Mario beyond the familiar rescue pattern after a new enemy takes over Bowser's castle. Towns, conversations and a travelling party give the journey a different scale.

Battles use commands, but a button pressed at the right moment can strengthen an attack or improve defence. This keeps a small physical action inside the turn-based structure. Choosing a move and carrying it out are connected, leaving room for both planning and practice.

Mallow and Geno join familiar figures including Bowser and Peach. Having a former enemy and the usual rescue target take roles in the party changes how Mario's world is encountered. The expanded cast gives battles different abilities while giving the adventure people to talk to, disagree with and rely on.

proposed_canonical.summary: Call of Duty: Warzone launched in March 2020 as a free-to-play game from Infinity Ward and Raven Software.
body: Call of Duty: Warzone launched in March 2020 as a free-to-play game from Infinity Ward and Raven Software. At launch, up to 150 players entered Verdansk in teams of three. It supported crossplay, allowing the same match to bring together friends using PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC.

The Gulag gave an eliminated player a one-on-one fight for a chance to return. Teammates could also spend in-match cash at Buy Stations to recover a fallen squad member. These systems made a defeat something the squad could respond to, instead of always ending that person's participation immediately.

Cash paid for equipment and other advantages, while optional Contracts offered rewards for taking on another task. Plunder made collecting cash the central goal and allowed repeated respawns. The two launch modes used the same broad environment to produce different reasons to move, take a risk or help a teammate.

proposed_canonical.summary: A fairground accident sends Crono across centuries, while combined attacks make the travelling party matter in battle.
body: Crono meets Marle at Guardia's Millennial Fair. They visit Lucca's Telepod demonstration, and a malfunction sends Marle into the past. Crono follows with her pendant. A public celebration becomes the doorway to a journey through different periods of the same planet, released by Square in 1995.

Prehistory, the medieval world and the distant future give the journey different surroundings and companions. The premise makes travelling through time a practical way of exploring a world. The collaboration brought together Dragon Quest creator Yuji Horii, Final Fantasy creators and Akira Toriyama's character designs.

In battle, action gauges fill while enemies change position. Characters can combine their special Tech abilities into joint attacks. Waiting for another party member can therefore create a different opportunity from acting immediately. The people travelling together affect both the story's company and the choices available during a fight.

proposed_canonical.summary: Yakuza 0 places two young men inside the property deals, nightlife and criminal pressure of Japan in 1988.
body: In December 1988, a small vacant plot interrupts a major redevelopment scheme in Kamurocho. Kazuma Kiryu, a twenty-year-old debt collector, becomes implicated in a killing. The supposedly empty land has owners, claimants and consequences. A property dispute gives the 2015 prequel a concrete reason for rival interests to collide.

Across the country in Osaka's Sotenbori district, twenty-four-year-old Goro Majima manages the Grand cabaret. His successful public role sits beside punishment and exclusion from the organisation he wants to rejoin. Moving between the two protagonists lets the same period appear through very different kinds of obligation.

SEGA's story places luxurious redevelopment beside people whose lives can be redirected by a single order. Kiryu's predicament begins with an ordinary collection job; Majima's apparent status does not give him freedom. That contrast makes the prequel more than a younger face for a familiar protagonist: each city gives ambition a price.

Two cities, two young men
Money makes the pressure visible

proposed_canonical.summary: Bloodborne encourages the wounded hunter to make a difficult choice: withdraw, or strike quickly enough to recover.
body: Bloodborne arrived on PlayStation 4 in 2015 with Yharnam's streets and inhabitants as its threatening introduction. FromSoftware's hunter must study opponents while exploring the city. The original launch guidance treats caution as useful preparation, but it also gives players a strong reason to move towards danger after being hit.

Lost health briefly remains recoverable through successful attacks. That window makes an injury into a decision: try to win the health back now, or retreat and spend a healing item. An aggressive response can help, but repeating it without reading the enemy can turn one mistake into another.

Trick weapons change form, altering their attacks and reach. Firearms and carefully timed responses add further possibilities, while Blood Vials supply healing. Learning a fight consequently involves more than memorising a safe distance. The hunter's available tools can change that distance and the opportunities worth pursuing.

body: Diablo III: Reaper of Souls launched for Windows and Mac on 25 March 2014. Its fifth act takes the fight to Westmarch and Malthael, while the Crusader joins the playable classes. The increased level cap of seventy extends character development alongside the new section of the campaign.

Not every improvement associated with this period required buying the expansion. Blizzard's launch announcement distinguishes its new content from the preceding free update, which revised loot and Paragon progression and added social features. That distinction matters when tracing how an existing online game changed for different groups of players.

Adventure Mode reorganises the world around Bounties and randomised Nephalem Rifts rather than following the campaign in order. The Mystic also provides ways to adjust equipment. Completing the story is no longer the only structure available for another session: choosing tasks and refining a character become an alternative reason to return.

proposed_canonical.summary: Pillars of Eternity used crowdfunding to support a new role-playing world built around the strengths of older computer RPGs.
body: Obsidian announced in March 2015 that Pillars of Eternity had gone gold, with release set for 26 March on Windows, Mac and Linux. The project began its crowdfunding campaign in September 2012 as Project Eternity. Kickstarter and PayPal contributions together brought in more than four million dollars.

The studio named Baldur's Gate, Icewind Dale and Planescape: Torment among its influences. It was making a new setting and rules rather than another licensed entry in those series. That combination offered backers something recognisable while giving the team room to build a world whose details it controlled.

The finished release followed roughly two and a half years of development. The funding story makes the relationship between audience and production unusually visible: players committed support before there was a completed game to buy. Obsidian's gold announcement marks the point where that proposal became software ready for release.

Recognisable influences, original rules
From a campaign to a finished game

proposed_canonical.summary: Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G makes a portable hunting party and continuity with an existing save part of its appeal.
body: Monster Hunter Portable 2nd G launched for PSP in Japan on 27 March 2008. Capcom's English investor announcement called it Monster Hunter Freedom 2G. The later western release is known as Freedom Unite. Keeping those names and dates separate prevents a Japanese launch from being silently relabelled as the western one.

Ad-hoc wireless play allowed nearby players to hunt together. Capcom emphasised this cooperative portable experience in its contemporary announcement. A difficult quarry gave the group a shared task, while the handheld hardware made meeting up with the other hunters part of arranging the session.

Save transfer from the preceding game let returning players carry progress forward rather than begin the expanded release empty-handed. Capcom reported two million units shipped in Japan by 24 April, twenty-nine days after launch. That is a dated shipment measure, not a claim about sales to players or the later worldwide total.

Bring the hunting party together
Keep the progress already made

proposed_canonical.summary: Kingdom Hearts brought an original travelling party into Disney worlds and made that unlikely meeting the basis of a new series.
body: Kingdom Hearts first released in Japan for PlayStation 2 on 28 March 2002. The collaboration between Square and Disney brought Sora, an original young protagonist, together with Donald Duck and Goofy. The familiar characters were companions in a continuing adventure rather than a collection of unrelated guest appearances.

Their journey moves through Disney worlds threatened by the Heartless. Sora's Keyblade connects that travelling party to the larger conflict. Recognisable characters and places provide an entry into a story that also asks the player to follow new relationships, so prior familiarity with Disney is useful without explaining everything in advance.

The first game later appeared within collections and on other platforms. Those packages bring different points in the series together, but the original 2002 release was its starting point. Looking back from the many sequels makes the initial proposition strikingly simple: three unlikely companions have to travel together.

proposed_canonical.summary: Yoshi’s Crafted World uses the backs of its handmade stages to turn familiar places into a different search.
body: Yoshi's Crafted World launched on Nintendo Switch on 29 March 2019. Good-Feel built its stages from the appearance of paper, cartons, cups and other household materials. The Yoshis pursue the scattered gems of the Sundream Stone, with a landscape that openly shows how its scenery has been assembled.

The Flip Side turns most stages around, exposing the backs of their props. The new objective is to locate three hidden Poochy Pups and reach the end quickly. A route already crossed becomes another search because changing the view reveals objects that the front-facing composition concealed.

Two players can share the adventure, with one Yoshi carrying another on its back. Mellow Mode adds wings to help clear obstacles. These options allow different approaches to the same spaces. The handmade style supports both: a stage can be an obstacle course, a small scavenger hunt or something to explore together.

proposed_canonical.summary: Thimbleweed Park turns a small-town mystery into a shared investigation across five playable characters.
body: Ron Gilbert announced Thimbleweed Park's release on 30 March 2017. The mystery is set in 1987, in a town with an abandoned circus, a strange hotel and a burnt-out pillow factory. A body under a bridge brings investigators into a place whose other problems quickly demand attention.

Five playable characters bring different concerns into the same story. Agents Ray and Reyes investigate, while aspiring developer Delores, the clown Ransome and the ghost Franklin have their own situations to resolve. Switching between them lets the player see connections that no single character initially understands.

Gilbert and Gary Winnick returned to a point-and-click adventure form associated with their earlier work. The publisher offered Casual and Hard modes, varying the puzzle challenge within the same mystery. The 2017 release and its fictional 1987 setting therefore do different jobs: one dates the production, the other supplies the world being investigated.

A new game in an older form

body: A sick traveller searches the ruins of Hyper Light Drifter for knowledge that might save them. Heart Machine released the game for computers on 31 March 2016. Broken machines and unfamiliar monuments suggest a history that the player must piece together, while the Drifter has an urgent reason to keep moving.

Alex Preston described a deliberate move away from long explanations: encounters and conversations would communicate through images. Landmarks, colour and animation carry information that another game might put into dialogue. The player reads a place by crossing it, noticing what survived and what remains dangerous.

Combat brings a different kind of attention. Enemies react visibly to blows, and groups require more than repeating an attack against a passive target. Disasterpeace, the composer Rich Vreeland, supplies an uneasy musical atmosphere. Exploration can feel quiet without becoming safe; the ruins remain beautiful places to be afraid in.

The developer compared its scoring to a skating game: style and combinations matter, except the tricks become acts of demolition. Steam Workshop support also lets players create goats, levels and missions. body: Final Fantasy VI begins with an empire turning recovered magic into military power, and people trying to resist it. Square released the Super Famicom game in Japan on 2 April 1994. Its world has rebuilt itself with steam and machinery, but an older destructive force has returned.

Terra, called Tina in the Japanese version, has been controlled and used as an imperial weapon. Escape brings her into contact with the Returners. Their allies have different reasons to fight: Locke carries the memory of someone he could not protect, while Edgar balances the safety of his kingdom against opposition to the empire.

That shared struggle does not guarantee that the world can be preserved. Kefka brings catastrophe rather than a defeat neatly contained at the end of a quest. The story follows people whose losses matter beyond the immediate battle. A large fantasy conflict is held together by smaller questions about family, loyalty and a reason to continue.

proposed_canonical.summary: The Elder Scrolls Online brought a series associated with solitary journeys into a world shared with other players.
body: The Elder Scrolls Online brought a series associated with solitary journeys into a world shared with other players. Developed by ZeniMax Online Studios, it launched for PC and Mac on 4 April 2014. PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions were still in development at that point.

Bethesda presented several ways to inhabit Tamriel: undertaking quests alone, exploring with a few friends, or joining large battles against other players. Those activities put different demands on the same world. A place has to support a personal adventure while also accommodating people who arrive with their own companions and aims.

The launch statement described battles involving hundreds of participants and reported five million beta registrations. Registrations are not sales or a count of simultaneous players, but they show the scale of interest Bethesda was communicating. The central experiment was already clear: could an Elder Scrolls journey retain its appeal when the next adventurer was another person?

body: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga rebuilds nine films as a galaxy that players can explore as well as retell. TT Games developed the game with Lucasfilm Games, and Warner Bros. Games published it on 5 April 2022. Players can begin with the opening episode of any of the three trilogies.

The galaxy map connects the familiar stories to travel between planets. A journey can include a space battle, then a landing and a choice between continuing the plot or looking for quests and puzzles. The films provide a route, but the player is also invited to stop along it.

Kyber Bricks reward exploration and contribute to upgrades across character classes, including Jedi, scavengers and droids. Unlockable characters make free play another way to revisit places. LEGO humour changes the tone of recognisable scenes without requiring a different saga: a serious adventure can become a family playground built from the same characters and locations.
